name: MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 (Magnetic + UV)
description: The MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 (Magnetic + UV) is a unique shape-mod puzzle that challenges you to solve based on shape rather than color. This upgraded version features a magnetic positioning system for improved stability and control, making turns feel more precise. The UV-coated surface adds a glossy finish that enhances both aesthetics and grip, ensuring a premium solving experience.
